# Italy

> [!summary] Data available
> Very well covered for dishes and recipes: the largest non-US cuisine in [[RecipeDB2]] (≈16,580), [[CulinaryDB]] (7,504) and [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] (7,410), plus 258 [[FmLAMA]] dishes. There is no Italian food composition table in the vault and no [[BLEnD]] file. Human evidence comes from [[Exposome-Explorer]] (523 rows; ORDET, InCHIANTI, EPIC).

## Foods & dishes
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈16,580 recipes labelled Italian in v1 (region "Italian" 16,582), the largest regional label; amounts, steps and nutrition, but not released (samples only).
- [[CulinaryDB]]: 7,504 Italy recipes (ingredients, partial amounts, no method).
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 7,410 recipes tagged `italian` (steps, nutrition, no amounts; often Italian-American).
- [[IndicRecipeNutri]]: 978 "Italian" recipes from Indian sites (gram weights, method tags, nutrition).
- Dish inventories: [[FmLAMA]] 258 dishes (2,975 rows, the most rows of any country; e.g. acquacotta, agnolini, amaretti); [[WorldCuisines]] 99 dishes (71 Italy-only; arancini, risotto, cotoletta alla milanese); [[World Wide Dishes]] 6 (3 Italy-only; risotto, tortellini, tiramisu). Ingredient lists only.
- No [[BLEnD]] file for Italy.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table for this country is in the vault or `Backlog/`; use [[USDA FoodData Central]] (and [[FooDB]] / [[Phenol-Explorer]] for compounds) by name matching. The Italian tables (CREA / BDA-IEO) are not yet candidates.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 378 plants on the map (the most in Europe); [[NPASS]] 205 species–compound pairs collected in Italy.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- **Human-cohort evidence:** [[Exposome-Explorer]] 523 Italian rows (471 concentrations, 19 correlations, 33 cancer associations), from the ORDET cohort (27 breast-cancer rows), InCHIANTI and EPIC.
- Traditional use: [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] ETHNOBOT 100 records (70 taxa); [[KNApSAcK Family]] World lists the country (edible/medicinal species records; counts for European countries were not scraped).
- No Italian herbal or Mediterranean-diet compound dataset is in the vault.
- Global backbone via [[Global]]: [[FooDB]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[CTD]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions.

## Gaps
- No Italian FCT and no Italian-language recipe corpus; RecipeDB2's large Italian set is not released.
- No everyday-knowledge QA (no BLEnD file); regional cuisines only as dish names.
